newsitem.title: OMAN: Commercial Bank, Oman Savings vote to merge.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Bank, Oman Savings vote to merge.

text.p: Shareholders of the Oman Savings and Finance Bank and the Commercial Bank of Oman (CBO) have voted on a merger, a local newspaper reported on Sunday.
The Arabic-language daily Al-Watan said the merger agreement was signed on Saturday. The new bank will be called the Commercial Bank of Oman.
The banks decided that a new chairman of the board would be chosen within three months, the newspaper said.
The new bank's authorised capital would be 50 million rials, while the paid-up capital would be 33.3 million rials, it added.
The banks' combined assets are 200 million rials.
Both banks had previously recommended that one CBO share should be equal to one Oman Savings share.
In October Australia and New Zealand Banking Group sold its branches in Oman to the new Oman Savings, which was listed earlier this year.
